ai_summary: JSW Dulux Limited has received a Show Cause Notice from the Karnataka GST Department seeking approximately Rs. 10.61 crore due to the disallowance of Input Tax Credit for the period April 2022 to March 2023. This amount, comprising tax, interest, and penalty, represents a significant potential financial liability for the company. While JSW Dulux is preparing to respond to the notice, this action signals a potential red flag regarding their GST compliance or tax position.
